placement.claim: Each long-running role workflow owns the meaning of its resume-critical operational projection and transition lineage, while referencing stronger domain and runtime owners. Retained history must be deterministically queryable in temporal sequence and support reading or reconstructing a selected retained revision without repeating effects. A future UI may project that sequence visually. The shared durable-state primitive may supply opaque publication mechanics without owning semantics. Concrete history representation, role-profile schemas, physical hosting, and broader control-plane allocation remain provisional and must be resolved from exercised consumer evidence.

reopening_conditions: An exercised role profile shows that workflow meaning or a recovery-critical operational consequence belongs to a stronger existing domain owner rather than the role workflow.
Identity, parent/child topology, visibility, or lifecycle-query consumers require a different split among source policy, authoritative ownership, enforcement, observation, and projection.
A role recovery vertical cannot reconstruct correctly from a role-owned projection plus references to stronger domain artifacts.
No viable publication or history realization can provide fenced, crash-safe, idempotent, integrity-checked and explainable reconstruction without transcripts, Git reflogs, or model recollection.
Observed writer replacement, authorization, event reconciliation, handoff, retention, or cleanup requirements cannot be represented without changing the proposed semantic contract.
Independent-review recovery shows that preserving findings outside the provider session compromises the required independence boundary.
Dogfooding shows that a proposed profile duplicates stronger packet, receipt, checkpoint, schedule, review, authority, or repository state rather than referencing it.
Evidence establishes a shared control-plane owner for one of the currently provisional identity, topology, visibility, lifecycle, or runtime-binding consequences.

authority.decision_owner: user or future explicitly authorized architecture owner

relationships.rationale: Proposal packets own durable candidate and decision context. This proposal defines a candidate contract for role workflows to preserve unfinished operational position while referencing packet state rather than duplicating it.
The related history candidate exercises the transition-lineage and visual-replay consequences required by this semantic contract without making one physical history mechanism universal.
